tokens.name: hall-violet
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary buttons, active navigation, links, sold booths, the mark. As text it holds 6.6:1 on `paper` and 7.1:1 on `surface-raised` in light; 5.7:1 on `surface-raised` in dark.

tokens.name: on-hall-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `hall-violet` fill: white in light (7.1:1), near-black in dark because the dark-theme violet is lighter (6.6:1).

tokens.name: violet-tint
tokens.usage: Reserved booths and soft brand fills. Put `ink` (light) or `on-accent` text on it (7.8:1).

tokens.name: badge-yellow
tokens.usage: The one highlight: the selected booth, the badge printing now, a key number, the middle bar of the mark. Fill only, never text; put `on-accent` on it (12.9:1). At most one yellow element per screen.

tokens.name: lanyard-coral
tokens.usage: Marketing accent only: the floorplan pattern, illustrations, campaign tags. Never in product UI, never to mean an error. Put `on-accent` on it (6.0:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `badge-yellow`, `lanyard-coral`, `violet-tint` and `status-warning`, in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headlines on `paper` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table meta, control borders and free-booth outlines. Holds 4.5:1 on `paper` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background, and the tiles of the floorplan pattern.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, dialogs and free booths that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, dividers, the hatching on blocked booths. Decorative only; control borders use `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: PAID, CHECKED IN, CONFIRMED. Fill with `on-status` text (5.3:1). Always with the word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: DUE SOON, PENDING, EXPIRING. Fill with `on-accent` text (10.0:1). Always with the word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: OVERDUE, DENIED, FAILED. Fill with `on-status` text (5.6:1). Always with the word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: SENT, DRAFT, IN PROGRESS. Fill with `on-hall-violet` text.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: CANCELLED, ARCHIVED, NOT STARTED. Fill with `on-status` text (6.2:1).

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on `status-success`, `status-danger` and `status-neutral` fills.

tokens.name: booth-free
tokens.usage: Free booth on a floorplan: `surface-raised` fill, 1.5px `ink-muted` outline, `ink` booth code.

tokens.name: booth-reserved
tokens.usage: Reserved booth (held, not paid): `violet-tint` fill, `on-accent` booth code.

tokens.name: booth-sold
tokens.usage: Sold booth: `hall-violet` fill, `on-hall-violet` booth code.

tokens.name: booth-blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked booth (pillar, service area, not for sale): 45° hatching in `line` over `paper`, `ink` booth code.

tokens.name: booth-selected
tokens.usage: The booth in focus: `badge-yellow` fill, 2px `ink` border, `on-accent` booth code. Only one at a time.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: landing heroes, event-day screens, the check-in kiosk welcome. Set font-stretch 125% where Archivo loads.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Assign the booth, send the invoice and print the badge from one record.
styles.usage: All running text and form inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text, table values that matter, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, status tags, column headers. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Booth codes, badge IDs, invoice numbers, square metres: anything people read back over the phone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls; floorplan booth gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, form field spacing, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections; page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Booth tiles, tags, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing panels and the printed badge outline.
